                                  MEMORANDUM
To:               Planning Commission
From:             Planning Department
Date:             May 28, 2026
Subject:          26-8019 “Walmart Electric Vehicle Charging Stations,” an amended site plan
                  to be located at 13502 West Hamilton View Road. Applicant – Julie Hekking


This application is a public hearing and administrative action item.
In reviewing the application the Planning Commission is serving an administrative function to determine if the project
meets city ordinance and standards. Decisions are based on substantial evidence.

Example Motion
I move the Planning Commission approve application PLZ 26-8019, Walmart EV Stations
Amended Site Plan, with the following conditions:

    1. Site Plan Improvements shall be consistent with the plans presented to the Planning
       Commission except where otherwise noted.
    2. Existing Trees shall be protected during construction. Trees Removed shall be
       replaced with a similar species tree with a caliper of 2-inches or greater.
    3. Sod area east of the parking lot, between the parking curb and the public sidewalk shall
       remove the existing sod and sprinklers and landscape the area with a water wise
       landscape plan that includes vegetation to screen the electrical equipment.


Background

This is a Public Hearing for an amended commercial site for a Walmart Supercenter located at
13502 South Hamilton View Road to add Electrical Vehicle (EV) charging stations.

Walmart was constructed in 2007 on a 22-acre site near 13400 South and 3600 West.
Walmart has remodeled and updated the store several times, most recently an online fulfillment
center was approved for the buildings west site.

This proposed site plan amendment for EV charging stations would add eight (8) charging
stations and an accessible walking route to the east side of the site. An upright charging
station would be shared by two stalls and would be located near the stalls front. A picture of
the upright charging unit is included in the attached plan set.

To make room for the 8 charging stations 18 existing stalls would be removed. A net reduction
in 10-stalls. Additionally an ADA Accessible walking route would be added from the charging
stations to the store front. This walking route would cut through four existing parking islands

Report by: TJP
5/22/2026
resulting in a portion of the landscaping being removed from each of the islands. No trees will
be removed.

Electricity for the charging stations would come from a new transformer and switch board
installed in the grass landscaping area east of the parking lot. The transformers will be
installed on concrete pads and stand above the ground.

Since the proposed site plan amendments removes several landscaping areas, and places
large electrical equipment in sodded areas that are poorly screened and also irrigated with
broadcast sprinklers designed for watering sod, staff is recommending the Commission require
the sodded area between the parking lot and the public sidewalk be removed and replaced with
a water wise landscaped area that will protect the electrical equipment from sprinklers and also
screen the electrical equipment.



Attachments
The following items are attached:

         1. Public Noticing
         2. Site Plan Application
         3. Site Plans (including charger elevations).
